source: Koning, W. J. F., Johnson, W., Grip, H. F., "Improved Mars Helicopter Aerodynamic Rotor Model for Comprehensive Analyses", AIAA Journal 57(9), 2019, pp. 3969-3979, doi:10.2514/1.J058045, Fig. 25 (open circles: JPL Space Simulator measurements).

conditions.note: Coaxial pair, full-scale rotor. C_T = T_total / (rho A (Omega R)^2), C_P = P_total / (rho A (Omega R)^3) with the area A of ONE disk (checked: the paper's maximum thrust 13.25 N gives C_T = 0.0243, the last point). The measured shaft power is the motor power times a constant 78 % motor/drive efficiency (Koning, Johnson, Allan 2018).

method: Digitised from the published figure (rendered at 300 dpi): marker centres by ring-template correlation, axes from the detected grid lines (C_T 0.005 per 122.8 px, C_P 1e-3 per 58.7 px). Estimated digitising uncertainty: +-0.0002 in C_T and +-0.03e-3 in C_P.
